meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去查 DepMap 的癌症细胞系数据:取基因依赖分数(CRISPR Chronos)、药物敏感性和基因效应,产出选择性依赖清单、生物标志物关联与共依赖分析结果。
howto.when: 当你做肿瘤靶点验证、合成致死筛选或药物敏感性分析,或问某基因在特定突变细胞系里是否必需时,它会接管。

say.text: KRAS 在肺腺癌细胞系里的依赖分数是多少?
say.note: 返回 Chronos 依赖分数和细胞系列表

say.text: 找出 BRCA1 突变细胞系中的合成致死基因
say.note: 按突变型与野生型比较基因效应

say.text: 分析这个化合物的 PRISM 敏感性与基因组特征相关性
say.note: 把药物敏感度与突变、表达数据关联

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude queries DepMap cancer cell line data: CRISPR Chronos gene dependency scores, drug sensitivity and gene effect profiles, returning selective dependency lists, biomarker associations and co-essentiality results.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you validate oncology targets, run synthetic lethality screens or analyze compound sensitivity, or ask whether a gene is essential in cell lines with a given mutation.

say_en.text: What is the KRAS dependency score across lung cancer cell lines?
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores plus a cell line list

say_en.text: Find synthetic lethal partners in BRCA1-mutant cell lines
say_en.note: Compares gene effect in mutant vs wild-type lines

say_en.text: Correlate this compound's PRISM sensitivity with genomic features
say_en.note: Links drug response to mutation or expression data
